consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1973-02-26 show features standout performances, particularly in the Dark Star and Eyes of the World segments. While some reviewers feel the show doesn't hold up against other February shows, many praise the energy and musicianship throughout.
standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower>I Know You Rider
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.2 for 21 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While there are many high praises for specific songs, some reviewers express disappointment in the overall show compared to other performances from the same period.
